info.title: Loop Factory API
info.description: REST API for the Loop Factory puzzle game. All competitive scores are derived from server-verified move replays.

post.summary: Create an anonymous guest account and receive server-issued credentials
Rotate a refresh token (single use; reuse revokes the session family)
Link a Google/Apple identity to this account, or switch to the account that already owns it (restore after reinstall)
Revoke the refresh-token family of this session

delete.summary: Delete account and all associated data

post.summary: Upload queued offline operations (idempotent by opId) and receive the merged snapshot

get.summary: Today's (or a recent) official daily puzzle

post.summary: Submit a move replay; the server re-simulates it and ranks by verified rotation count

get.summary: All-time ranking by verified campaign solves
ISO-week ranking by dailies solved, then rotations
Achievements unlocked by the current player
Export all personal data as JSON

post.summary: Erase the account and all data (immediate, irreversible)
Verify a store purchase server-side and grant the entitlement
